tldr.text: TCS reported Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 73,188 crore, representing constant currency growth of 0.5% QoQ and 2.8% YoY.
tldr.evidence: Revenue for the quarter was ₹73,188 crore . In constant currency, revenue grew 0.5% sequentially and 2.8% year-on-year .

tldr.text: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion, crossing 10% of total company revenue.
tldr.evidence: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of our overall revenue.

tldr.text: Quarterly TCV stood at $9.6 billion, excluding major strategic deals such as Porsche and Best Buy.
tldr.evidence: TCV for the quarter was US$9.6 billion . This excludes the Porsche and Best Buy deals.

tldr.text: Operating margin remained flat sequentially at 24%, while net margin stood at 19%.
tldr.evidence: Our operating margins remained stable sequentially at 24% . ... Our net margins for the quarter were 19% .

management_commentary.text: TCS continued investing in strategic partnerships, M&A initiatives, and niche talent to build long-term capabilities.
management_commentary.evidence: In Q2, we made investments in strategic partnerships, M&A-related initiatives, and hiring of niche talent.

management_commentary.text: Near-term skills and delivery needs were met by increasing subcontractor hiring and maintaining a higher bench capacity.
management_commentary.evidence: As we build future capacity and navigate demand transitions, we have invested in a higher bench and increased hiring of subcontractors to meet near-term skills and delivery requirements.

management_commentary.text: LTM attrition in IT services decreased by 30 basis points sequentially to 13.3%, with total associates at 598,056.
management_commentary.evidence: taking our workforce to 598,056 associates. ... LTM attrition in IT services reduced by 30 basis points sequentially to 13.3% .

management_commentary.text: Strategic engagements like Porsche/MHP acquisition and Best Buy GCC highlight TCS's focus on AI mobility and AI-native GCC transformations.
management_commentary.evidence: Our partnership with Porsche and the proposed acquisition of MHP , which is subject to regulatory approvals, strengthen our position in AI powered mobility and engineering. - The Best Buy GCC engagement highlights our ability to help clients build and transform AI-native global capability centers.

guidance.text: TCS maintains its policy of not providing specific quarterly or annual revenue and earnings guidance.
guidance.evidence: As you are aware, we don't provide any specific revenue or earnings guidance

guidance.text: Management expects MHP acquisition-related dilution to impact operating margins by approximately 50 basis points depending on timing and integration.
guidance.evidence: The acquisition-related dilution, particularly in MHP, is likely to impact by about 50 basis points depending on the timing of closure and when the integration starts.

guidance.text: Over the medium term, management remains confident that revenue growth momentum will continue based on TCV, deal pipeline, and client discussions.
guidance.evidence: on a medium-term basis, looking at the TCV, looking at the pipeline and the client conversations that we are having, we're confident that growth momentum will continue.

segment_performance.notes: Strongest large vertical; grew 2.5% QoQ and 3.9% YoY in constant currency, supported by banking, capital markets, and insurance.
segment_performance.evidence: BFSI was our strongest large vertical and the largest contributor to growth, with 2.5% sequential and 3.9% year-on-year growth in constant currency .

segment_performance.notes: Grew 3.1% QoQ and 4.2% YoY in constant currency, led by factory automation, industrial AI, and supply chain projects.
segment_performance.evidence: Manufacturing grew 3.1% sequentially and 4.2% year-on-year . Demand is improving around factory automation, engineering productivity

segment_performance.notes: Grew 3.1% QoQ and 4.8% YoY in constant currency, driven by enterprise software, cloud modernization, and engineering.
segment_performance.evidence: Technology and Services grew 3.1% sequentially and 4.8% year-on-year . Growth was driven by enterprise software, technology products, engineering

segment_performance.notes: Declined 0.7% QoQ and 1% YoY in constant currency due to inflation sensitivity and discretionary spending cuts.
segment_performance.evidence: Consumer Business declined by 0.7% sequentially and 1% year-on-year . Retail and consumer products remain sensitive to inflation, energy costs, and selective consumer spending.

segment_performance.notes: India revenue grew 6% YoY and Regional Markets grew 3.6% YoY, though India experienced sequential revenue pressure from a project deferral.
segment_performance.evidence: India revenue grew 6%, and Regional Markets grew 3.6% year-on-year. ... In India, we had a project deferral, which caused this revenue decrease.

segment_performance.notes: Grew 1.2% QoQ in constant currency across all regions, led by UK at 3.5%, followed by North America and Continental Europe at 0.4% each.
segment_performance.evidence: International revenue grew 1.2% sequentially in constant currency. All international markets grew sequentially , led by the United Kingdom at 3.5%, followed by North America and Continental Europe at 0.4% each.

key_metrics.evidence: Our quarterly revenue was ₹73,188 crore , a growth of 1.3% sequentially and 11.2% on a year-on-year basis.

key_metrics.evidence: In dollar terms, revenue was $7,642 million , a growth of 20 basis points sequentially and 2.4% year-on-year.

risks.text: Continued selectivity and scrutiny on discretionary spend programs without immediate business value.
risks.evidence: The demand environment has not materially changed since last quarter, and discretionary programs without near-term value remain under scrutiny.

risks.text: Margin headwinds in H2 FY27 from MHP acquisition dilution (~50 bps), seasonal furloughs, and elevated ecosystem investments.
risks.evidence: The acquisition-related dilution, particularly in MHP, is likely to impact by about 50 basis points depending on the timing of closure and when the integration starts. The normal furlough seasonality and our continued ecosystem investments would be our headwinds.

risks.text: Ongoing operational pressure in the telecom sector dragging on Communications and Media performance.
risks.evidence: Communications and Media was broadly flat , with growth in media, publishing, and digital platforms o Ư set by continued pressure in the telecom vertical.

tone.label: positive
tone.rationale: Management emphasized steady sequential growth momentum in international markets, strong order book wins ($9.6 billion TCV), fast scaling AI revenues ($3.1 billion annualized), and broad-based vertical performance.
tone.evidence: First , we sustained our growth momentum this quarter, despite an environment that remains selective and uneven. ... Fourth , AI continues to scale as a structural growth opportunity. Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion

item.question: On the subcon increase this quarter, should we see this as a proxy for visa cost?
item.answer: Subcontractor increase occurred across India and overseas primarily to address near-term skill mismatches, though partially influenced by visa fees.
item.evidence: Sudheer Guntupalli: On the subcon increase this quarter, should we see this as a proxy for visa cost ... Samir Seksaria: The overall increase in subcon has been across India as well as overseas. It is more to meet near-term demand-supply skill mismatches.

item.question: What caused this revenue decline in India?
item.answer: The sequential decline in India revenue was caused by a project deferral, with no structural issues present and recovery expected in subsequent quarters.
item.evidence: Ravi Menon: what caused this revenue decline in India? ... K Krithivasan: In India, we had a project deferral, which caused this revenue decrease. Otherwise, there's no structural issue

item.question: Samir, could you quantify how much of the gross margin impact is structural and what headwinds exist for H2?
item.answer: Subcontractors and third-party expenses impacted gross margins; H2 headwinds include MHP dilution of ~50 bps, furloughs, and ecosystem investments.
item.evidence: Ruchi Mukhija: Samir, could you quantify how much of this we see structural ... Samir Seksaria: The acquisition-related dilution, particularly in MHP, is likely to impact by about 50 basis points depending on the timing of closure and when the integration starts.

item.question: Is AI revenue accretive to gross margins at the company level?
item.answer: The $3.1 billion annualized AI revenue streams come in at significantly higher margins than the overall company average.
item.evidence: Gaurav Rateria: Is that accretive to the gross margins at the company level? ... Samir Seksaria: On the first one, the $3.1 billion AI revenues which we have are coming in at a much higher margin than our company average.

item.question: Why have delivery partner and software costs grown at ~40% YoY?
item.answer: These expenses reflect incremental delivery fulfillment, partnership cost acceleration, and upfront capacity creation for future revenue growth.
item.evidence: Rishi Jhunjhunwala: For the past 2to 3 quarters, these costs have been growing at almost 40% year-on-year ... Samir Seksaria: It is investing into the capacity for the growth that will come with a lag.

item.question: What was the fresher hiring volume for this quarter?
item.answer: TCS onboarded 10,000 university graduates globally during the year and is finalizing campus hiring for next financial year.
item.evidence: Ashwin Mehta: And the last one was in terms of fresher hiring this quarter. What did we have? ... Sudeep Kunnumal: We onboarded 10,000 graduates from the University this year globally.
